name: G481, Kevin's production shape (invented names): 5.05 now, 77.91 due 23 Nov, about 649.59 expected 26 Nov: the money in offsets the bill, so the account is 5.05 and not Short

expected.notes: Today is Thu 19 Nov 2026 and pay is the last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov (8 days away): the window is days 0 to 7 and anything dated on payday belongs to the next period. Harbour Current (the only account) holds 5.05. Its bill: HOMEBRIDGE HOUSING 77.91 on Mon 23 Nov. One predicted credit, 649.59 on Thu 26 Nov, seen twice at equal amounts a month apart, so predicted and attributed to the account. G481 (Kevin 2026-11-20): Available = cash now - max(0, bills before payday - money in before payday); money in only offsets bills and never adds, and no timing or day-by-day order is involved. Bills before payday 77.91, money in before payday 649.59: 5.05 - max(0, 77.91 - 649.59) = 5.05 - 0 = 5.05. Left to spend 5.05, not Short (the money in cannot add: the figure is not 576.73). The cover engine agrees: the closing walk (credits first) is 5.05 + 649.59 - 77.91 = 576.73 after payments and its low point is the 5.05 opening, so covered; no move; at risk 0.
